purpose: Read-only investigation of Livingstone parcel alignment against the visible OSM base map. This finding is not a source correction or parcel admission decision.

observation.geometryComparisonMethod: Bidirectional nearest corresponding-coordinate comparison in a local longitude/latitude metre approximation. Leaflet omits the repeated closing coordinate when exposing ring vertices. Every source vertex matches a displayed vertex to floating-point precision.

canvasCheck.result: Projected first vertices agree with the Leaflet canvas path points and renderer bounds; no extra screen-space displacement observed.

osmComparison.name: Mukuni Park
osmComparison.interpretationLimit: A mapped park land-use outline and a cadastral lot are not necessarily the same legal footprint. OSM is a comparison reference, not survey control.
osmComparison.method: Approximate local metres using longitude scale at latitude -17.844 and 111320 metres per degree. Four visually corresponding outer corners are compared; OSM includes additional edge vertices.
osmComparison.conclusion: The outlines differ in extent and shape; a constant translation cannot reconcile this park comparison.

imageryComparison.result: Aerial imagery was viewed with the unchanged cadastral outlines. Visible discrepancies remain around some roads and physical features. Native zoom 19 returned placeholders; zoom 17 supplied actual imagery.
imageryComparison.limit: Qualitative visual corroboration only. Image acquisition date, imagery positional accuracy and surveyed boundary coincidence were not established.

datumEvidence.currentSource: Current Lots layer reports WGS84 / UTM zone 35S (EPSG:32735).
datumEvidence.historicalLayoutStatement: A separate ZILMIS layout describes a WGS84 map document and Arc1950 zones 34S/35S/36S.
datumEvidence.limit: This does not prove that the current Livingstone lot geometry is mislabeled or establish a correction. No official Livingstone-specific offset or prescribed transformation was found.

conclusions: The app displays the official source coordinates without a material coordinate or canvas shift in the tested window.
The cadastral source and OSM reference disagree visibly; boundary interpretation, source accuracy, age and georeferencing remain unresolved.
Topology and bounded query qualification do not establish positional agreement with a base map or surveyed boundaries.
Do not apply an empirical translation or relabel the source datum on the basis of this one visual comparison.
nextCheck: Validate multiple well-defined street or boundary control features across Livingstone against authoritative current imagery or survey control, distinguish land-use outlines from legal lots, and obtain the publisher’s coordinate/datum and accuracy metadata before any source correction.
